levels_rule: above-ground storeys times factor plus source roof:height or explicit estimated allowance; excludes basement storeys
landmark_proxy_reason: Temporary distinguishable massing for later E/L review; no source metre height obtained
derived_part_rule: Maximum valid single height among explicitly linked components is a source-derived coarse envelope, not measured or detailed shape
missing_or_ambiguous_part_and_roof_heigh: hold_reference; do not invent total height from roof thickness
ambiguous_height: hold; no first/max/min/average or implicit levels fallback
height_semantics: height is top offset from local foundation including roof; min_height is bottom offset; span=height-min_height
ground_datum: local engineering support plane; no sea-level datum or observed topography
support_plane_extent: envelope of all retained horizontal features plus padding; not playable boundary
terrain_exception_policy: steps/bridge/tunnel/nonzero or invalid layer/underground/water require separate review; no automatic ground placement
